'''Elenar''' is an apprentice [[Wise One]] of the [[Daryne]] [[Aiel]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Elenar}} 

She is the apprentice who is farthest along in her studies, and [[Amys]] thought she should go to [[Rhuidean]], but [[Bair]] did not think she was ready.

== Trivia ==
* Elenar is named for Eleanor Pettener, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
